expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The bottom navigation sits very close to the system gesture indicator area, and the dark gesture bar visually overlaps/crowds the center nav icons, making the tab bar look cramped or struck-through.
Horizontally scrolling sections such as categories and 'Fastest near you' show items clipped at the right edge with limited visual affordance beyond the partial card/chip.
Favorite heart buttons and bottom navigation icons are icon-only and may not expose clear labels to screen readers or users who rely on visible text.
Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and restaurant details uses light gray coloring that may be difficult to read in bright conditions.

expected.reasoning: Both describe the bottom navigation being visually compromised by the gesture bar overlapping/crowding the icons, though reported issue also mentions labels being cut off implicitly through the crowding effect.
